mentions.name: Source
mentions.description: An experimental Git server written in Go that stores repositories in a database rather than on a filesystem. It relies on databases for durability, replication, and distribution instead of introducing complex distributed filesystem infrastructure into the stack.
mentions.problem: Avoids the need for complex distributed filesystem infrastructure in the stack to get durability, replication, and distribution for Git repositories.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on Source [1], an experimental Git server written in Go.

Source stores repositories in a database rather than a filesystem [2]. The primary goal is to rely on databases for durability, replication, and distribution, rather than introducing complex distributed filesystem infrastructure into the stack.
